_help: Everything Ramanan says and plays lives in this file. Audio names refer to files in assets/characters/ramanan/audio/ (.wav or .mp3).
dialogues: Ramanan comes to you, shows the text and plays its audio. Add as many as you like.
Optional per dialogue: "pose" (neutral, nail-look, looking, looking-up, warning, apologies, confused, angry, laughing, cheer) and
"action" after OK (cheer, spin). Leave them out to pick at random.
ok: the button label, and the audio played when the user clicks it.
mouse: text and/or audio for click, dblclick, dragStart, drop and hover. Text is optional.
goodbye: played (text + audio) when Ramanan is switched off and walks away.
NOTE: the texts below are placeholders made from the clip names. Replace each with what the clip really says.
